title: ML Ops Telkomsel
description:
Built a centralized MLOps platform for Telkomsel's AI teams, accelerating model delivery across the AI lifecycle.
• Streamlined the end-to-end ML lifecycle - experiment, register, deploy, monitor - across multiple squads
• Removed the data-science to production-engineering hand-off bottleneck with role-aware, collaborative workflows
• Shipped a scalable, responsive UI used daily by cross-functional AI teams

title: Qlola Cash Management
description:
Frontend engineer on BRI's enterprise cash-management platform - a high-throughput banking web app serving corporate clients.
• Optimized rendering and data handling for massive financial datasets, noticeably improving dashboard load and interaction smoothness
• Delivered responsive, accessible banking flows under strict performance budgets
• Collaborated in a large-scale monorepo with multiple teams shipping to production frequently

title: IFG Life Corporate Website
description:
Delivered IFG Life's corporate website and CMS end-to-end using a micro-frontend architecture.
• Split the landing site and CMS into independently deployable modules, cutting release risk and enabling parallel team velocity
• Achieved strong performance scores through SSR, lean assets, and careful code-splitting
• Standardized reusable components and tooling across the frontend stack

title: Next Live Mading
description:
Thesis project benchmarking SSR vs CSR data-fetching performance with two production-grade architectures.
• Designed and measured comparative performance data, producing actionable insight into when to choose each strategy
• Full-stack delivery: Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL
• Shipped a working product, not just a prototype - with a strong thesis result

title: Office Booking
description:
Built a Jakarta office-space rental platform connecting businesses with workspaces in the city's business districts.
• Designed intuitive search and booking flows plus admin dashboards for listings, customers, and marketing history
• Implemented business analytics (Chart.js) to support negotiation and marketing decisions
• React + Material UI, fully responsive across devices

title: Research Submission System
description:
Developed a grant and reviewer-incentive submission system for lecturers and staff.
• Automated submission, review, and incentive workflows, cutting manual administrative overhead
• Role-based approval flows with clear reporting for administrators
• Built with Laravel and designed to scale with the institution's research volume

title: System Monitoring Sales Furniture
description:
Built an inventory and sales monitoring system for a furniture business.
• Automated transaction code generation and error handling, eliminating manual entry mistakes during high-volume transactions
• Gave management real-time visibility into stock in-and-out flows
• Java application with supporting libraries, hardened against transaction edge cases

title: New Student Registration Application
description:
Digitized the enrollment process for Lokasari State Elementary School in Cipanas.
• Automated participant cards, pass/fail filtering, and principal validation - replacing manual paperwork
• Reduced manual processing time during the enrollment season
• Java application tailored to the school's workflow

title: Dynamic Portfolio Website
description:
Self-initiated portfolio built to production-grade standards - my proof-of-work for entering the industry.
• Implemented a GraphQL + Apollo data layer with a reusable component architecture
• Fast, responsive, and SEO-conscious delivery
• React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
